hero.subtitle: 12-Week Student Project
hero.tagline: Chaotic multiplayer racing with procedural audio

overview.title: Project Overview
overview.desc: Solo audio designer on 8-person team. 320+ audio events, 100% MetaSounds implementation.
overview.role_desc: Solo audio designer: sound design, implementation, mixing. 2 programmers, 3 artists, 12 weeks.
overview.tech_desc: MetaSounds procedural audio. Parameter-driven modulation. Priority-based mixing.
overview.result_desc: Released itch.io May 2025. Windows/Linux. 1-4 local multiplayer.

metasounds.title: MetaSounds Implementation
metasounds.desc: Procedural audio system. Real-time parameter modulation.
metasounds.what: Node-based procedural audio. Parameters driven by gameplay (speed, surface, player count).
metasounds.result: Reactive audio. Speed changes pitch. Surfaces crossfade smoothly. <2MB per instance.
metasounds.placeholder_desc: Node graphs showing boost system, surface detection, collision audio. Pending Perforce recovery.

triggering.title: Audio Triggering
triggering.desc: Simple conditional checks trigger MetaSounds directly. No delegates.

surface.title: Surface Transitions
surface.problem: Instant surface switches caused pops. Rapid transitions = audio spam.
surface.solution: 150ms crossfade. 0.2s cooldown. Equal-power curve. Smooth material changes.

mix.title: 4-Player Mix
mix.problem: 4 players = stacked sounds. UI feedback inaudible.
mix.solution: Max 4 collisions. EQ per slot. Sidechain duck (-6dB, 50ms/200ms).

memory.title: Memory Spikes
memory.problem: 4-layer boost = 40MB per instance. x4 players = 160MB spike.
memory.solution: Procedural MetaSound: noise + filter + pitch. <2MB per instance. RPM curve for organic feel.

overview.title: Przegląd Projektu
overview.desc: Jedyny audio designer w 8-osobowym zespole. 320+ eventów audio, 100% MetaSounds.
overview.role_desc: Audio designer solo: sound design, implementacja, mixing. 2 programistów, 3 artystów, 12 tygodni.

metasounds.title: Implementacja MetaSounds
metasounds.desc: System proceduralnego audio. Modulacja w czasie rzeczywistym.
metasounds.what: Audio proceduralne oparte na nodach. Parametry sterowane gameplayem (prędkość, powierzchnia, ilość graczy).
metasounds.result: Reaktywny audio. Prędkość zmienia pitch. Powierzchnie płynnie crossfade. <2MB na instancję.
metasounds.placeholder_desc: Grafy nodów pokazujące system boost, detekcję powierzchni, audio kolizji. Czeka na odzyskanie z Perforce.

triggering.title: Triggerowanie Audio
triggering.desc: Proste warunkowe checky triggerują MetaSounds bezpośrednio. Bez delegatów.

surface.title: Przejścia Powierzchni
surface.problem: Natychmiastowe zmiany surface powodowały popy. Szybkie przejścia = spam audio.
surface.solution: 150ms crossfade. 0.2s cooldown. Krzywa equal-power. Płynne zmiany materiału.

mix.title: Mix 4-Graczy
mix.desc: Mixing oparty na priorytetach. Zapobiega maskowaniu częstotliwości.
mix.problem: 4 graczy = stackowane dźwięki. UI feedback niesłyszalny.
mix.solution: Max 4 kolizje. EQ per slot. Sidechain duck (-6dB, 50ms/200ms).

memory.title: Skoki Pamięci
memory.problem: 4-warstwowy boost = 40MB na instancję. x4 graczy = 160MB skok.
memory.solution: Proceduralny MetaSound: szum + filtr + pitch. <2MB na instancję. Krzywa RPM dla organicznego feelu.
